## Intent

The doc comment on `getProfileData` in the profile feature still carries the line "TODO: Add organizationId parameter
when multi-workspace support is added (see CLAUDE.md)". That TODO is stale and misleading: workspaces have existed for
months, the profile page is personal-only by an earlier decision (the `profile-personal-only` increment), the function
reads only one person's `user` and `user_profiles` rows, and the project instructions it points to say nothing about it.
A reader who trusts the TODO would think an organization id is still owed to this function.

The owner wants the TODO replaced by one sentence in the same doc comment that states the actual rule: the profile is
per person, not per workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id. Nothing else about the function changes.

## Scope

**In scope:**

- Removing the stale TODO line from the `getProfileData` doc comment in the profile feature.
- Adding one sentence to that doc comment stating that the profile is per person, not per workspace, so `getProfileData`
  takes no organization id.
- A test that reads the profile feature's source text and checks both of the above.

**Out of scope (non-goals):**

- Any change to `getProfileData`'s signature, return value, queries, logging or its E2E fixture branch.
- Any other comment, file or doc outside the profile feature, including the project instructions file and the
  architecture docs.
- Adding workspace-scoped profile data of any kind.
- Changing or deleting any existing profile unit test.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-1** Given the files under `features/profile/` When the text of every one of them is read Then no file contains
  the text "multi-workspace support", and no file contains a TODO line that mentions an `organizationId` parameter
  - verify: unit
- **AC-2** Given the source of `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` When the doc comment that sits directly above
  the `getProfileData` declaration is read Then that doc comment contains the words "per person" and the words
  "no organization id"
  - verify: unit

## Constraints

- No behaviour change: `getProfileData` keeps its exact signature (`(userId: string) => Promise<ProfileData>`), its
  return value and its E2E fixture branch.
- AC-3 — Given the existing profile unit tests When they run after the change Then they pass unchanged (no existing
  test file is edited to make them pass).
- The added text is one sentence; the rest of the existing doc comment (what the function reads and the defaults it
  falls back to) stays.

## Assumptions

- AC-3 holds before the build, so it is a constraint.
- A unit test that reads source files from disk and asserts on their text counts as observing a returned value (the
  file's contents); this increment changes only a comment, so no runtime surface can observe it.
- The sentence may be worded freely as long as it contains the phrases "per person" and "no organization id" (for
  example: "The profile is per person, not per workspace, so this function takes no organization id."); the test checks
  those two phrases, case-sensitively, within the `getProfileData` doc comment only.
- "A TODO line that mentions an `organizationId` parameter" means a line containing both "TODO" and "organizationId";

- The test written for AC-1 does not itself trip AC-1: it either lives outside `features/profile/` or never carries the

- The project's `test` script (`vitest run`) runs the new unit test; no end-to-end runner is needed.
